🔥 android-sms-gateway | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling programmatic sending and receiving of SMS messages through an API, integrating SMS functionality into other applications and services.
✨ Key Features: • Send and Receive SMS via API • Support for Android 5.0 and above • Multipart messages • Message status tracking • Incoming messages viewer
📖 Summary: The Android SMS Gateway app transforms an Android device into an SMS gateway, allowing users to send and receive SMS messages programmatically via an API. It supports features like multipart messages, message status tracking, and real-time notifications for incoming messages through webhooks.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 ClovaLink | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing a secure, cost-effective, and self-hostable enterprise file management solution for businesses that require advanced features and full data control, especially those managing multiple clients or tenants.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-tenant file management • Secure APIs
📖 Summary: ClovaLink is a self-hostable, multi-tenant file management platform built with Rust and React, designed to offer enterprise-grade features at a significantly lower cost than commercial solutions. It provides secure APIs, extensible metadata, external identity provider integration, and pluggable storage backends, making it ideal for businesses seeking control over their data and compliance.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 ESP32-Bit-Pirate | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Hardware hacking, debugging, and analysis of various digital and radio communication protocols.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-protocol support (I2C, SPI, UART, 1-Wire, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, RFID, etc.) • Interactive command-line interface (CLI) via USB Serial or WiFi Web • Protocol sniffing capabilities • EEPROM and Flash manipulation tools • Scripting support
📖 Summary: ESP32 Bit Pirate is an open-source firmware that transforms an ESP32 device into a versatile hardware hacking and analysis tool. It supports a wide array of digital and radio protocols, offering features like sniffing, sending, scripting, and interactive control via a web-based CLI.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 textual-web | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To make Textual applications and terminals accessible and shareable via web URLs, allowing users to run them in a browser without local installation.
✨ Key Features: • Serve Textual applications in the browser • Serve terminals in the browser • Generate public URLs for shared applications/terminals • Configuration via TOML file for multiple apps/terminals • Customizable URL slugs
📖 Summary: Textual Web allows users to run and share Textual applications and terminals directly in their web browser. It bridges the gap between powerful terminal-based applications and the accessibility of the web, enabling easy sharing and remote access.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 swarms | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Orchestrating and managing complex multi-agent AI systems in production environments.
✨ Key Features: • Enterprise-grade multi-agent orchestration • Production-ready architectures (sequential, concurrent, hierarchical) • Scalable and adaptive systems • Backward compatibility with leading agent frameworks • Interoperability with protocols (MCP, x402, skills)
📖 Summary: Swarms is an enterprise-grade, production-ready framework for orchestrating multi-agent systems. It provides scalable and adaptive architectures for sequential, concurrent, and hierarchical agent interactions, with backward compatibility and interoperability with various AI protocols.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 imgcompress | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a self-hosted, all-in-one solution for local image processing, including compression, format conversion, and AI background removal, prioritizing user privacy and data ownership.
✨ Key Features: • Supports 70+ image formats (HEIC, PSD, AVIF, EPS, PDF, etc.) • Local AI background removal (no API keys or uploads)
📖 Summary: ImgCompress is a self-hosted, privacy-focused image processing server that runs entirely within a Docker container. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for image compression, format conversion (supporting over 70 formats), and AI-powered background removal, all accessible via a web UI or CLI without sending data to external services.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
